item.title: [6.1] Bellman-Consistent Trajectory RL for LLM Arithmetic Reasoning
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

To address sparse terminal rewards in LLM arithmetic reasoning, we propose a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method. Our framework introduces Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization (TBRM) to transform sparse rewards into dense token-level signals. We integrate a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) group strategy to reduce gradient variance of Bellman residuals and use hindsight goal relabeling...

WHY IT MATTERS

Advances fundamental language model capabilities, reasoning efficiency, or training methodology.
